item: CI type-checks src a second time on requirements.lock's own pins (R318, option A)
summary: The test job's mypy run type-checks what -e .[analysis,dev,...] resolves, the newest release of every unbounded dependency, while an install from requirements.lock gets its pins; src/api/diagnostics/keywords.py was red on SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 (the lock) and clean on 2.1.4 and was found a day late (#1576). The lockfile-install job now runs a second, BLOCKING mypy over src/ on the lock's own set: it installs the mypy release pyproject's [dev] extra pins (read from pyproject, so the two cannot drift), installs the lock again with --require-hashes --no-deps to put back anything mypy's install moved, runs pip check, then the test job's own mypy command, before the wheel step installs build. Measured: clean on the lock (761 files, about 22 s), and undoing one of #1576's two lines turns it red on SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 while the newest resolve (2.1.6) stays clean. tests/test_ci_mypy_lock_profile.py pins the step, its four commands and their order, the pin source and the step's place, with 22 mutants each named by the checker. CI/tooling: no release-notes line (R488).
